user.title: Connect to Aerotermia España
user.description: First register the machine on https://aerotermiaespana.sytes.net (step 1 of the panel, with the counter type set to Total). Then copy here the API key, the machine ID (#) and the assigned minute.

data_description.api_key: From your panel on the web.
data_description.installation_id: The number after # in the panel, e.g. 24.
data_description.minute: The minute the web assigned to your machine (step 3). Do not change it unless the web does.

device.title: Heat pump
device.description: Pick the ESPHome device of your heat pump (Midea-heat-pump-ESPHome firmware) to find its sensors automatically. Leave it empty to pick every sensor by hand.

sensors.title: Sensors
sensors.description: {detected} sensors were found. Only the electricity consumed and the heat produced are required. An empty field is simply not sent.

data_description.consumed_kwh: Lifetime counter that never resets. Detected: the machine's own meter. Pick an external meter (Shelly, Wibeee...) if you have one, it is more accurate.
data_description.outdoor_temp: Detected from the machine. Pick your own outdoor thermometer if you prefer.
data_description.indoor_temp: A room thermometer. The machine does not have one.
data_description.outdoor_humidity: From a weather station or outdoor probe. The machine does not have one.

advanced.name: Advanced: sensors detected from the machine
advanced.description: Found automatically. Only change them if you know what you are doing.

data_description.defrost_source: The integration counts every off to on change in its own Defrost Cycles Total sensor.
data_description.compressor_source: The integration counts every off to on change in its own Compressor Starts Total sensor.
